utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Registrar. On this Tuesday, I'd like to say good morning to all the people in the courtroom. [No interpretation] ... objections and responses that we had.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 3D submitted a list of objections to the OTP exhibits tendered through Witness CS. That will be given Exhibit number IC 213. 3D also submitted a list of objections to OTP exhibits tendered through Witness CT. That will be Exhibit number IC 215. And the OTP submitted a response to objections made by the Defence concerning Witness CR. That will be given Exhibit number IC 216. Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, might I be allowed to say two words? I've been informed Yes. I've been informed that you received the papers so I don't have to go into the details and take up court time.

utterances.speaker: MR. KOVACIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I've been informed that you received a short not from me, so I don't have to go into the details and take up court time. I'd like to request of the Trial Chamber to ask the CLSS to check something that appeared in the transcript. It was when CS testified, Witness CS testified on the 11th of January on page 12093, line 11, because in our opinion a word was erroneously translated and it is fairly important. We know what the word was in Croatia. I don't want to burden you with the discussion. Everything is explained on that piece of paper, and I hope I don't have to take up any of your time so please would you issue an order for the -- for CLSS to listen to the tape again and to have the passage concerned or word translated. And if necessary to correct the transcript of the 11th of January. Now, I'm at your disposal if there are any questions in that regard. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. I'm going to check that everything is working first, the microphones. Yes, they seem to be. Mr. Registrar, would you ask the interpretation service pursuant to Mr. Kovacic's request to look into the matter and check it out and let us know with respect -- this was with respect to the terms mentioned during the testimony of Witness CS. It was at page 12093, line 11. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let's move into private session now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 17th day of January, 2007, at 9.00 a.m. 23 24 25
